parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system license nat64.explanation: 配置设备的许可证类型。

set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-fi.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-fi.command: set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-filter term permit from source-address 2001:db8::1:1112/126
set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-fi.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的源地址条件。

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: 防火墙过滤器的术语名称。

set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-fi.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from destination-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-fi.command: set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-filter term permit from destination-address 64:FF9B::/96
set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-fi.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的目的地址条件。

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: 防火墙过滤器的术语名称。

set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-fi.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then [parameter3]
set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-fi.command: set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-filter term permit then accept
set firewall family inet6 filter ipv6-fi.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的动作。

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: 防火墙过滤器的术语名称。

set class-of-service classifiers ipv6-cl.command: set class-of-service classifiers ipv6-classifier forwarding-class best-effort
set class-of-service classifiers ipv6-cl.explanation: 配置服务质量分类器的转发类。

set policy-options policy-map p1 from ip.command: set policy-options policy-map p1 from ipv6-filter
set policy-options policy-map p1 from ip.explanation: 配置策略映射的源过滤器。

set policy-options policy-map p1 then tr.command: set policy-options policy-map p1 then translate nat64
set policy-options policy-map p1 then tr.explanation: 配置策略映射的转换动作。

set system high-availability.explanation: 启用系统的高可用性功能。

set chassis redundancy group 1 mode back.command: set chassis redundancy group 1 mode backup

set chassis redundancy group 1 preemptiv.explanation: 配置冗余组的抢占模式。

set chassis redundancy group 1 track int.template: set chassis redundancy group [parameter1] track interface [parameter2]
set chassis redundancy group 1 track int.command: set chassis redundancy group 1 track interface ge-0/0/1
set chassis redundancy group 1 track int.explanation: 配置冗余组跟踪的接口。

set chassis redundancy group 1 vrrp 1 ip.template: set chassis redundancy group [parameter1] vrrp [parameter2] ip [parameter3]
set chassis redundancy group 1 vrrp 1 ip.command: set chassis redundancy group 1 vrrp 1 ip 10.1.1.3
set chassis redundancy group 1 vrrp 1 ip.explanation: 配置冗余组的VRRP IP地址。

set service-instance-group group1 redund.explanation: 配置服务实例组的冗余组。

set service-instance-group group1 ip-pre.explanation: 配置服务实例组的IPv6前缀。

set security nat64 instance 1 address-gr.template: set security nat64 instance [parameter1] address-group [parameter2] start-address [parameter3] mask [parameter4]
set security nat64 instance 1 address-gr.command: set security nat64 instance 1 address-group 1 start-address 11.1.1.1 mask 255.255.255.0
set security nat64 instance 1 address-gr.explanation: 配置NAT64实例的地址组的起始地址和掩码。

set security nat64 instance 1 address-gr.template: set security nat64 instance [parameter1] address-group [parameter2] prefix [parameter3]
set security nat64 instance 1 address-gr.command: set security nat64 instance 1 address-group 1 prefix 64:FF9B::/96
set security nat64 instance 1 address-gr.explanation: 配置NAT64实例的地址组的IPv6前缀。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 vrrp-grou.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 vrrp-group 1 virtual-address 10.1.1.3

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 vrrp-grou.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 vrrp-group 1 priority 150

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: priority
parameters.explanation: VRRP组的优先级，数值越高优先级越高。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 vrrp-grou.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] vrrp-group [parameter3] track interface [parameter4] reduced [parameter5]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 vrrp-grou.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 vrrp-group 1 track interface ge-0/0/1 reduced 60
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 vrrp-grou.explanation: 配置VRRP组跟踪接口并设置优先级减少值。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: reduced-priority
parameters.explanation: 当被跟踪的接口不可用时，VRRP组的优先级减少的值。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 vrrp-grou.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 vrrp-group 1 delay 15

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: delay
parameters.explanation: VRRP组的延迟时间，单位为秒。

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family inet6 address 2001:db8::1:110f/126
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址及前缀长度。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 filter input [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family inet6 filter input p1
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6输入过滤器。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
